messages.content: Hi, someone rear-ended me at a red light on Elm St about an hour ago. Nobody hurt, but my trunk won't close. The other driver gave me her insurance info. What do I do now?

I'm glad no one was hurt. Here is where things stand.
Claim status: Not reported yet. You can file the first notice of loss now in Granite Mobile (Claims > Report a Claim) or on our 24/7 Claims Line at 555-0186; a GC- claim number is issued immediately. Add the other driver's insurance details and any photos from the scene.
Next step: If the car is drivable, use PhotoEstimate in Granite Mobile (8 photos: 4 corners, 2 damage close-ups, VIN plate, odometer) and your estimate will post within 2 business days. Because the other driver appears to be at fault, we will pursue subrogation and refund your deductible in proportion to what we recover, typically within 60–120 days.
Who will contact you: Your assigned auto adjuster will call you within 24 hours of the report.
big oak from my neighbors yard came down on our roof in last nights storm. theres a hole over the kids room and its still raining. HomeShield policy. please help

I'm so sorry, that sounds frightening. Please keep everyone out of that room.
Claim status: I can open your HomeShield claim right now as a first notice of loss; you'll receive a GC- claim number immediately.
Next step: Call the 24/7 Claims Line at 555-0186 and ask for Granite Rapid Response; a vendor can be dispatched within 4 hours to tarp the roof. If you hire someone yourself, keep the receipts: emergency mitigation is reimbursed up to $2,500 without pre-approval. Upload photos to ClaimTrack once it's safe.
Who will contact you: A property adjuster will reach out within 48 hours and schedule an adjuster visit within 3 business days. If this storm is declared a CAT event, those windows extend to 72 hours and 5 business days.
Got a rock chip in my windshield on the highway, about the size of a dime. Is this going to cost me my deductible? I have Granite Auto Basic.

Policy status: Good news: windshield chip repair is $0 deductible on every Granite auto tier, including Basic.
Next step: Report it in Granite Mobile under Claims > Report a Claim, choose Glass, and add a close-up photo of the chip. Try to get it repaired soon; if the chip spreads into a crack and the windshield has to be replaced, the comprehensive deductible would apply on Basic.
Who will contact you: Your auto adjuster will confirm the repair within 24 hours of your report.
My mortgage refinance lender is asking for my declarations page for the HomeShield policy. Where do I find that?

Policy status: Your declarations page is available any time in Granite Mobile under Policy > Documents, where you can download or share it as a PDF.
Next step: If the new lender also needs to be listed as mortgagee, send us the lender's name, loan number and mortgagee clause here. Lender changes are processed within 2 business days, and we send evidence of insurance to the lender directly.
Who will contact you: Our Policy Service team will confirm in Granite Mobile once the change is made, within 2 business days.
I signed up for SafeMiles 8 days ago and still no tag in the mail. Do I lose the discount?

Policy status: Your 5% SafeMiles enrollment discount is already applied and isn't affected by the shipping delay. The SafeMiles Tag SM-200 normally ships within 5 business days, so we'll check on yours.
Next step: Please confirm your mailing address in Granite Mobile > SafeMiles > Device. If the tag was lost in transit, we'll send a replacement at no charge.
Who will contact you: The SafeMiles team will reply here within 4 business hours with the tracking status.
My brother borrowed my car Saturday and apparently drove like a maniac, my SafeMiles score dropped 6 points. That wasn't me!

Policy status: Trips driven by someone else can be removed from your SafeMiles score as long as they are flagged within 7 days, so you're still in time.
Next step: In Granite Mobile, open SafeMiles > Trips, select Saturday's trips and tap "I wasn't driving." Your score recalculates once they're removed. Remember that SafeMiles never raises your premium.
Who will contact you: No call is needed. If the option doesn't appear, reply here and the SafeMiles team will fix it within 4 business hours.
Claim GC-318472. ClaimTrack has said 'Estimate' since Monday. Its Thursday. Body shop is waiting on you guys.

Thanks for including the claim number.
Claim status: GC-318472 is in the Estimate stage. PhotoEstimate results normally post within 2 business days of upload, so yours is overdue.
Next step: I've flagged the file to the auto claims team. If the body shop found additional damage, they can submit a supplement through ClaimTrack, which is reviewed within 2 business days.
Who will contact you: Your adjuster will call you and the shop by end of day tomorrow. If you don't hear back, Owen Thackeray, our Auto Claims lead, will follow up personally.
Car's going to be in the shop for about a week after my accident. Do I get a rental? Policy is Granite Auto Plus.

Policy status: Yes. Granite Auto Plus includes rental reimbursement of $40 per day for up to 30 days while your car is being repaired on a covered claim.
Next step: Pick up a rental and keep the receipt, or ask your adjuster to arrange one directly. Upload rental receipts to ClaimTrack under your claim.
Who will contact you: Your auto adjuster will confirm the rental authorization within 24 hours.
Why don't I have rental coverage?? I was in an accident yesterday and the person on the phone said a rental isn't covered. I pay you every month!

I understand the frustration, and I'm sorry this is happening at a stressful time.
Policy status: Your policy is Granite Auto Basic, which doesn't include rental reimbursement, so a rental isn't covered on this claim. Your repair claim itself is not affected.
Next step: You can add the rental endorsement for $4/month ($30/day for up to 30 days) in Granite Mobile or through Customer Care at 555-0129; it applies to future claims only. Granite Auto Plus includes $40/day rental if you'd like to compare.
Who will contact you: Your adjuster will call within 24 hours of your report to go over repair options.
Hi, I forgot my auto payment that was due on the 3rd, it's the 7th now. Am I going to get charged a late fee or lose coverage?

Policy status: Your policy is active. You have a 10-day grace period after the due date, and the $10 late fee only applies after it ends, so paying by the 13th means no fee and no interruption.
Next step: Pay in Granite Mobile under Billing > Make a Payment. Turning on autopay (EFT) also waives the $5 monthly installment fee going forward.
Who will contact you: No call needed; you'll get a payment confirmation in Granite Mobile right away.
Is there a discount if I pay the whole 6-month premium at once instead of monthly?

Policy status: Yes. Paying in full earns a 6% pay-in-full discount and also avoids the $5 monthly installment fee.
Next step: In Granite Mobile, go to Billing > Payment Plan and choose Pay in Full; the discount is applied to the remaining balance on your current term.
Who will contact you: Our Billing team will post your updated balance in Granite Mobile within 4 business hours.
Our basement floor drain backed up after the heavy rain and there's sewage everywhere. We have HomeShield Essential. Is that covered?

I'm sorry you're dealing with this.
Claim status: Not reported yet. Sewer and drain backup requires water backup coverage, which HomeShield Essential only has if the $6/month water backup endorsement was added. We'll check your declarations page for it when the claim is opened.
Next step: Please still file the first notice of loss in Granite Mobile or on the Claims Line at 555-0186 so an adjuster can confirm the cause, and take photos before cleanup. Avoid direct contact with the water.
Who will contact you: A property adjuster will reach out within 48 hours with a coverage decision.
pipe burst under the kitchen sink while we were at work, water everywhere, cabinets and floor soaked. HomeShield Plus. we shut the water off

Thank you for shutting off the water; that was exactly the right first step.
Claim status: A sudden burst pipe is covered under all-perils on HomeShield Plus, subject to your all-perils deductible. File the first notice of loss in Granite Mobile and you'll get a GC- claim number right away.
Next step: Call the Claims Line at 555-0186 to have Granite Rapid Response dispatched within 4 hours for water extraction, or hire your own crew and keep the receipts; emergency mitigation is reimbursed up to $2,500 without pre-approval.
Who will contact you: A property adjuster will call within 48 hours and schedule an adjuster visit within 3 business days.
Hail dented the whole hood and roof of my car yesterday. Is that collision or comprehensive? How do I get it looked at?

Claim status: Hail damage falls under comprehensive coverage, so your comprehensive deductible applies.
Next step: Report the claim in Granite Mobile, then either use PhotoEstimate (8 photos: 4 corners, 2 damage close-ups, VIN plate, odometer; the estimate posts within 2 business days) or drive in to a Drive-In Claim Center in Cedar Bluff, Ridgeview or Lowell Flats, Mon–Fri 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. MT, no appointment needed.
Who will contact you: Your auto adjuster will call within 24 hours of the report.
Adjuster says the hail damage to our roof is $14,200 but we have to pay a $7,000 deductible?? I thought my deductible was $1,000.

I understand the surprise; here's how the numbers work.
Claim status: Your $1,000 deductible is the all-perils deductible. Wind and hail damage uses a separate wind/hail deductible equal to 2% of Coverage A (dwelling). With $350,000 of Coverage A, that's $7,000, as listed on your declarations page.
Next step: Your settlement would be $14,200 minus $7,000. If you believe the estimate is missing damage, ask your adjuster to re-inspect; if you disagree with the coverage decision, you can request a review by our Claims Review Desk.
Who will contact you: Your adjuster will reply in ClaimTrack within 4 business hours; the Claims Review Desk responds within 2 business days if you request a review.
The body shop told me my car is probably 'totaled'. What does that actually mean and what happens next? Claim GC-207731

Claim status: GC-207731 is in the Estimate stage. A vehicle is a total loss when the repair estimate exceeds 75% of its actual cash value (ACV); your adjuster will confirm whether yours crosses that line.
Next step: If it is a total loss, we complete the valuation within 5 business days of the inspection and send the offer, title and lien paperwork through ClaimTrack. If you have rental coverage, it continues for 5 days after the offer.
Who will contact you: Your auto adjuster will call you with the valuation within 5 business days of the inspection.
Other guy ran a stop sign and hit me, his insurance already admitted fault. I paid my $500 deductible to get my car fixed fast. When do I get it back?

Claim status: Your repair has been paid and the file is in subrogation: we're recovering the costs, including your $500 deductible, from the other driver's insurer.
Next step: Nothing is needed from you. Once we recover, your deductible is refunded in proportion to the amount recovered, typically within 60–120 days.
Who will contact you: The auto claims team will message you in Granite Mobile as soon as the recovery posts, and the refund goes to your payment method on file.
Picked up a new SUV yesterday (traded in my old sedan). Do I need to call before driving it? Want to make sure I'm covered

Congratulations on the new SUV.
Policy status: A newly acquired vehicle is covered automatically for 14 days as long as you report it within those 14 days, so you're covered to drive it now.
Next step: Add it in Granite Mobile under Policy > Vehicles with the VIN and your lender's details if it's financed. Your new ID cards and declarations page will appear in Policy > Documents.
Who will contact you: Policy Service will confirm the change and any premium difference within 4 business hours.
My mortgage servicer sent a letter saying they have no proof of homeowners insurance and might force-place a policy. I've had HomeShield for 2 years!!

I'm sorry for the worry; let's get this cleared up quickly.
Policy status: Your HomeShield policy is active. Letters like this usually mean the mortgagee on file is outdated, for example after the loan was transferred to a new servicer.
Next step: Reply with the servicer's name, loan number and mortgagee clause from the letter. Mortgagee changes are processed within 2 business days, and we send evidence of insurance directly to the servicer. You can also share your declarations page from Granite Mobile > Policy > Documents in the meantime.
Who will contact you: Policy Service will confirm in Granite Mobile once the evidence is sent, within 2 business days.
Settlement for GC-551026 was signed last Tuesday, still no check. How long does this take

Claim status: GC-551026 is in the Paid stage. Payments are issued within 5 business days of a signed settlement, and a mailed check takes 7–10 business days to arrive.
Next step: If you'd like it faster and the check hasn't been cashed, we can void it and reissue by direct deposit through ClaimTrack, which lands 1–2 business days after issue.
Who will contact you: The claims payment team will reply here within 4 business hours to confirm the mailing date.
Filed a claim Saturday morning for a fallen fence and garage door damage, nobody from Granite has called. It's Tuesday afternoon. Claim GC-460219

I'm sorry for the delay; that's outside our standard.
Claim status: GC-460219 is in the Assigned stage. HomeShield claims should get first contact within 48 hours, so this is overdue.
Next step: I've escalated the file to Beatrix Holloway, our HomeShield Property Claims lead, to confirm your adjuster and book the adjuster visit, normally scheduled within 3 business days of the report.
Who will contact you: Your property adjuster will call you today before 8:00 p.m. MT.
Car died on the interstate near mile marker 212, hazards on. Do I have towing? I'm on Plus I think

Please stay buckled in the vehicle, or move well away from traffic if it's safe to do so.
Policy status: You're on Granite Auto Plus, which includes roadside assistance with towing up to 15 miles.
Next step: Request help now in Granite Mobile > Roadside (it shares your location), or call the 24/7 Claims Line at 555-0186.
Who will contact you: The roadside provider will text you an arrival time as soon as the request is dispatched.
We're moving out of state at the end of the month and need to cancel our auto policy. Is there a cancellation fee?

Policy status: There's no fee to cancel, and any unused premium is refunded pro rata within 10 business days of the cancellation date.
Next step: Make sure your new coverage starts on or before the day this policy ends so there's no gap, then call Customer Care at 555-0129 (Mon–Fri 7:00 a.m.–8:00 p.m., Sat 8:00 a.m.–2:00 p.m. MT) to set the cancellation date.
Who will contact you: Policy Service will send the cancellation confirmation to Granite Mobile, and your refund will follow within 10 business days.
This is my third message. My claim GC-372950 has been open 6 weeks, the adjuster doesn't return calls, and I want to file a formal complaint.

I'm sorry; six weeks without a clear answer isn't the experience we want for you.
Claim status: GC-372950 is in the Estimate stage.
Next step: I've filed a formal complaint with our Claims Review Desk, which handles complaints and coverage disputes, and copied Owen Thackeray, our Auto Claims lead, so your adjuster's open items are reviewed now.
Who will contact you: The Claims Review Desk will contact you within 2 business days. In the meantime, any message you send in ClaimTrack will be answered within 4 business hours.
Do I need an appointment at the Ridgeview drive in claim center? I can go Friday after lunch

Policy status: No appointment is needed. Drive-In Claim Centers in Cedar Bluff, Ridgeview and Lowell Flats are open Mon–Fri 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. MT, so Friday afternoon works.
Next step: Make sure the claim is reported in Granite Mobile first, and bring your GC- claim number and driver's license.
Who will contact you: Your adjuster will post the estimate in ClaimTrack within 2 business days of the inspection.
Which pictures does the app want for PhotoEstimate? It keeps saying incomplete.

Claim status: Your claim stays in the Inspection stage until all PhotoEstimate photos are uploaded.
Next step: PhotoEstimate needs 8 photos: the 4 corners of the vehicle, 2 close-ups of the damage, the VIN plate (driver-side dashboard or door jamb) and the odometer. Daylight photos work best.
Who will contact you: Once all 8 are in, your estimate posts in ClaimTrack within 2 business days, and your adjuster will call if anything else is needed.
my truck got towed to Harlan's Towing after the accident last night, front end smashed, not driveable. how does the inspection work if i cant drive it in

Claim status: Since the truck isn't drivable, PhotoEstimate and the Drive-In Claim Centers don't apply; an adjuster will inspect it where it is.
Next step: Make sure the claim is reported in Granite Mobile, and add the tow yard's name and address in ClaimTrack under Claim > Contacts so we can coordinate access. Storage fees add up, so tell us if you'd like it moved to a body shop.
Who will contact you: Your auto adjuster will call within 24 hours, and the inspection at the tow yard will happen within 3 business days.
My car was stolen from my apartment lot overnight. I already called the police. What do I need for the claim?

I'm sorry this happened.
Claim status: Not reported yet. Theft claims need the police report number at first notice of loss, so you're ready to file.
Next step: Report the theft in Granite Mobile (Claims > Report a Claim) or on the 24/7 Claims Line at 555-0186 with the police report number, where both sets of keys are, and any items left in the car. If the vehicle isn't recovered within 14 days, it's settled as a total loss.
Who will contact you: Your auto adjuster will call within 24 hours of the report.
Granite Mobile says my account is locked. I tried my password like 5 times. Need my ID card for some traffic stop paperwork

Policy status: Granite Mobile locks for 15 minutes after 5 failed sign-ins and unlocks on its own after that.
Next step: After 15 minutes, tap "Forgot password" on the sign-in screen to reset it. If you need your ID card sooner, call Customer Care at 555-0129 and we'll email it to the address on file.
Who will contact you: No callback is needed; reply here if the reset doesn't work and we'll respond within 4 business hours.
My SafeMiles score after the 90 days came out to 84. What discount does that get me at renewal?

Policy status: Nice driving. A SafeMiles score of 84 is in the 80–89 band, which earns a 15% discount at renewal in place of your 5% enrollment discount.
Next step: Nothing to do; keep the SafeMiles Tag SM-200 on your windshield so trips keep recording. A score of 90 or higher earns 25%.
Who will contact you: Your renewal offer with the discount applied will arrive in Granite Mobile ahead of your renewal date.
thinking about SafeMiles but i drive a lot at night for work (nurse). will it make my insurance go UP?

Policy status: No. SafeMiles never raises your premium. You get a 5% enrollment discount right away, and after the 90-day scoring period your renewal discount is based on your SafeMiles score: 90+ earns 25%, 80–89 earns 15%, 70–79 earns 10%, and below 70 you keep the 5%.
Next step: Enroll in Granite Mobile > SafeMiles; the SafeMiles Tag SM-200 ships within 5 business days.
Who will contact you: The SafeMiles team will message you in Granite Mobile with tracking when your tag ships, within 5 business days.
I sold my old car and forgot to take the SafeMiles tag off the windshield. Can I get another one for the new car?

Policy status: Yes. A replacement SafeMiles Tag SM-200 is free once per policy term, then $15 after that. Your SafeMiles score and discount carry over.
Next step: Make sure the new car is on your policy, then request the replacement in Granite Mobile > SafeMiles > Device > Replace Tag. It ships within 5 business days.
Who will contact you: The SafeMiles team will message you with tracking once it ships.
My daughter just got her license (she's 16). How do I add her to our auto policy and how much will it go up?

Congratulations to her!
Policy status: Drivers are added through Policy Service. The premium change depends on the vehicle she'll drive and your coverages, so we'll quote it before anything is finalized.
Next step: Add her in Granite Mobile under Policy > Drivers with her license number, or call Customer Care at 555-0129. Enrolling in SafeMiles can help offset the cost: it gives a 5% discount right away and never raises the premium.
Who will contact you: Policy Service will send the quote to Granite Mobile within 4 business hours of your request.
At the DMV right now and they want proof of insurance, how do i get my card quick

Policy status: Your ID cards are always available in Granite Mobile.
Next step: Open Granite Mobile > Policy > Documents and tap ID Card; you can show it on your phone or share it as a PDF. If you can't sign in, call Customer Care at 555-0129 and we'll email it to you.
Who will contact you: No callback is needed; reply here if the card doesn't load and we'll respond within 4 business hours.
Can I lower my collision deductible from $1,000 to $500? And would it apply to the fender bender I reported last week?

Policy status: Yes, collision deductible options are $250, $500 or $1,000. A deductible change takes effect the next day and doesn't apply to open claims, so last week's claim keeps the $1,000 deductible.
Next step: Request the change in Granite Mobile under Policy > Coverages; you'll see the premium difference before you confirm.
Who will contact you: Policy Service will confirm the change and post your updated declarations page within 4 business hours.
We had a kitchen fire Sunday, the fire dept says the house isn't livable for a while. We're staying at a motel. Does HomeShield pay for that?

I'm so sorry, and I'm glad everyone is safe.
Claim status: Additional living expenses (ALE), like the motel and the extra cost of meals, are covered while your home is unlivable: up to 6 months on HomeShield Essential and up to 12 months on HomeShield Plus.
Next step: File the first notice of loss in Granite Mobile or on the Claims Line at 555-0186 if you haven't yet, and keep every motel and meal receipt to upload in ClaimTrack.
Who will contact you: A property adjuster will call within 48 hours and schedule an adjuster visit within 3 business days.
Someone broke into our house and took a laptop, a TV and some jewelry. Will I get what it costs to buy new stuff?

I'm sorry about the break-in.
Claim status: Not reported yet. Contents are paid based on your tier: HomeShield Plus pays replacement cost, and HomeShield Essential pays actual cash value (the depreciated value), less your all-perils deductible in both cases.
Next step: File the claim in Granite Mobile with the police report number, then upload receipts, photos or serial numbers for each item in ClaimTrack.
Who will contact you: A property adjuster will reach out within 48 hours of the report.
hit a deer last night on Route 9, headlight and bumper busted. is that my fault? will my rate go up

Glad you're okay.
Claim status: Hitting an animal is covered under comprehensive, not collision, so it isn't treated as an at-fault accident; your comprehensive deductible applies.
Next step: Report the claim in Granite Mobile and, if the car is drivable, use PhotoEstimate (8 photos: 4 corners, 2 damage close-ups, VIN plate, odometer). With a broken headlight, please avoid night driving until it's repaired.
Who will contact you: Your auto adjuster will call within 24 hours of the report.
ClaimTrack moved my claim to 'Settlement'. What am I supposed to do?

Claim status: Settlement means your adjuster has finalized the amount, and the settlement is waiting for your signature in ClaimTrack.
Next step: Review the breakdown and sign it in ClaimTrack. Payment is issued within 5 business days of signing: direct deposit lands 1–2 business days after issue, and a mailed check takes 7–10 business days.
Who will contact you: If you have questions about the amount, message your adjuster in ClaimTrack and they'll reply within 4 business hours.
Shop found a bent frame rail after taking the bumper off. Your estimate didn't include it. Who pays for this?

Claim status: Hidden damage found during the repair is handled as a supplement to your existing estimate, so it can be added to the claim.
Next step: Ask the shop to submit the supplement with photos through ClaimTrack; if they aren't already listed, add them under Claim > Contacts. Supplements are reviewed within 2 business days.
Who will contact you: Your auto adjuster will contact you and the shop with the decision within 2 business days of receiving the supplement.
Why is my roof check made out to me AND my mortgage company? Now I have to chase them to sign it. Annoying.

I understand it adds a step.
Claim status: Your claim is Paid. HomeShield dwelling payments over $10,000 must list the mortgage company as co-payee, since they have a financial interest in the home.
Next step: Contact your mortgage company's loss draft department to endorse the check; many release the funds in stages as the repair progresses. Contents and ALE payments aren't co-payable and can go to you by direct deposit.
Who will contact you: Your property adjuster can send the mortgage company a copy of the estimate on request; message them in ClaimTrack and they'll reply within 4 business hours.
How do I set up autopay? I keep getting charged the $5 fee.

Policy status: The $5 monthly installment fee is waived as soon as autopay (EFT) is active.
Next step: In Granite Mobile, go to Billing > Autopay and add your checking account; it starts with your next installment.
Who will contact you: Billing will confirm your enrollment in Granite Mobile within 4 business hours.
I just got a notice saying my policy will be canceled for nonpayment. I lost my job last month and fell behind. What can I do?

I'm sorry you're going through this, and thank you for reaching out early.
Policy status: Your policy is still active. The cancellation notice gives you 20 days to pay the past-due amount, and paying within that window keeps coverage in place with no lapse.
Next step: Pay in Granite Mobile > Billing, or call Customer Care at 555-0129 to review options such as a lower-cost tier. If the policy does cancel, it can be reinstated with no lapse within 30 days if paid in full with a signed no-loss statement.
Who will contact you: Felix Arundel's Policy Service & Billing team will call you within 1 business day to go over your options.
Half the neighborhood got hit by that hail storm. My adjuster visit isn't until next week. Is that normal??

Claim status: Your HomeShield claim is in the Assigned stage. That storm was declared a CAT event, so adjuster visits are being scheduled within 5 business days instead of the usual 3.
Next step: If water is getting in, call the Claims Line at 555-0186 for Granite Rapid Response tarping; emergency mitigation up to $2,500 is reimbursed without pre-approval. Upload photos to ClaimTrack in the meantime.
Who will contact you: Your property adjuster will confirm the visit date and time by phone within 72 hours of your report.
Windshield cracked all the way across from the cold snap. I have Premier. What do I owe?

Claim status: Nothing. Granite Auto Premier includes $0 deductible windshield replacement.
Next step: Report it in Granite Mobile under Claims > Report a Claim > Glass with a photo of the crack, and pick a time for the replacement.
Who will contact you: Your auto adjuster will confirm the replacement appointment within 24 hours.
What's 'accident forgiveness'? My coworker says Granite has it.

Policy status: Accident forgiveness is included with Granite Auto Premier: your first at-fault accident won't raise your premium. It isn't part of Basic or Plus.
Next step: You can compare tiers and upgrade in Granite Mobile under Policy > Coverages. Premier also includes $0 windshield replacement, a 50-mile tow and $60/day rental reimbursement.
Who will contact you: Reply 'quote' and Policy Service will send a Premier quote to Granite Mobile within 4 business hours.
Can I switch from Plus to Premier today so the accident forgiveness covers the fender bender I had yesterday?

Policy status: You can upgrade to Premier at any time, but coverage changes apply only from their effective date forward, so accident forgiveness wouldn't apply to yesterday's accident.
Next step: Make sure yesterday's accident is reported in Granite Mobile (Claims > Report a Claim). If you'd still like Premier going forward, request it under Policy > Coverages.
Who will contact you: Your auto adjuster will call within 24 hours of the claim report, and Policy Service will confirm any upgrade within 4 business hours.
Parts are backordered and my car will be in the shop another 3 weeks. Rental is at day 24. Can you extend it?

Claim status: Your claim is in the repair phase. Rental reimbursement runs for up to 30 days on every tier that includes it, so coverage ends at day 30 even if repairs take longer.
Next step: Ask the shop for the parts ETA in writing and upload it to ClaimTrack; your adjuster can check whether an alternate part or a different shop would shorten the delay. Rental days after day 30 would be at your own cost.
Who will contact you: Your auto adjuster will reply in ClaimTrack within 4 business hours to review the repair timeline with you.
My roofer wants to talk to the adjuster directly about the scope of work. Can I give him permission?

Claim status: Your HomeShield claim is in the Estimate stage.
Next step: Add your roofer in ClaimTrack under Claim > Contacts with his name, company and email. Once he's authorized, the adjuster can discuss the scope with him directly; you'll still sign the settlement yourself.
Who will contact you: Your property adjuster will reply in ClaimTrack within 4 business hours to set up a call with him.
Mail carrier slipped on our icy front steps and says she hurt her wrist. She mentioned filing against our homeowners. What happens now?

Thank you for letting us know right away.
Claim status: Not reported yet. Injuries to visitors on your property are handled under the liability coverage of your HomeShield policy.
Next step: Report it in Granite Mobile or on the Claims Line at 555-0186 with the date, time and what happened. Please don't discuss fault or agree to pay anything directly; your adjuster will handle communication with her.
Who will contact you: A property adjuster will call you within 48 hours of the report.
kids baseball went through our living room window lol. replacement quote is $480. worth filing?

Claim status: Not reported. Your HomeShield all-perils deductible is listed on your declarations page; if it's the default $1,000 (or $500), a $480 window falls below it and the claim wouldn't pay out.
Next step: Check your deductible in Granite Mobile > Policy > Documents. In most cases it makes sense to pay for this one directly.
Who will contact you: No call is needed. If you'd still like to file, reply here and we'll open the claim; an adjuster would contact you within 48 hours.
Someone keyed both sides of my car in the Lowell Flats mall garage. Do I need a police report?

Sorry, that's frustrating.
Claim status: Not reported yet. Vandalism is covered under comprehensive, with your comprehensive deductible.
Next step: A police report isn't required for vandalism, but it helps; include the report number if you file one. Report the claim in Granite Mobile, then use PhotoEstimate or drive in to our Lowell Flats Drive-In Claim Center (Mon–Fri 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. MT, no appointment needed).
Who will contact you: Your auto adjuster will call within 24 hours of the report.
We close on a new house on the 15th and sell the old one the same week. Can we just move our HomeShield over?

Congratulations on the new home.
Policy status: The new house needs its own HomeShield policy effective on the 15th. The old policy can be canceled once the sale closes, with no cancellation fee and a pro rata refund within 10 business days.
Next step: Call Customer Care at 555-0129 with the new address and your lender's mortgagee clause; we send evidence of insurance to the new lender directly, within 2 business days.
Who will contact you: Policy Service will send your new HomeShield quote to Granite Mobile within 4 business hours.
If I file a claim for when someone backed into me, will my premium go up even though it wasn't my fault?

Policy status: Not-at-fault claims are recovered through subrogation from the other driver's insurer and aren't counted as at-fault accidents. On Granite Auto Premier, even a first at-fault accident is covered by accident forgiveness.
Next step: Report the claim in Granite Mobile with the other driver's information. Once we recover from their insurer, your deductible is refunded in proportion to the recovery, typically within 60–120 days.
Who will contact you: Your auto adjuster will call within 24 hours of the report.
Got a text saying it's from Granite Insurance, says my claim payment is on hold and asks for my SSN and bank login to release it. Is that real?

Sent a message to my adjuster in ClaimTrack yesterday morning at 9 and nothing. Thought you guys answer same day?

Who will contact you: Your adjuster will reply to your ClaimTrack message by 12:00 p.m. MT today.
Is customer care open on weekends? I work M-F and can only call saturday

Policy status: Yes. Customer Care at 555-0129 is open Saturdays 8:00 a.m.–2:00 p.m. MT (weekdays 7:00 a.m.–8:00 p.m. MT, closed Sundays). The Claims Line at 555-0186 is open 24/7 for new claims and roadside.
Next step: Most policy and billing changes can also be done any time in Granite Mobile, or you can send us a message there.
Who will contact you: Messages sent in Granite Mobile are answered within 4 business hours.
I filed a claim for a scratch but my brother-in-law fixed it for $150. Can I cancel the claim? GC-129844

Next step: Reply 'withdraw' here to confirm, or message your adjuster in ClaimTrack.
Who will contact you: Your auto adjuster will confirm the closure in ClaimTrack within 4 business hours, and the status will change to Closed.
Update on my stolen car claim GC-283615: police found the car!! It's at the impound lot, looks like the ignition is damaged. What now?

Great news that it was recovered.

Next step: Add the impound lot's name and address in ClaimTrack under Claim > Contacts. With a damaged ignition it likely isn't drivable, so an adjuster will inspect it at the lot. If repairs exceed 75% of the car's actual cash value, it will be handled as a total loss.
Who will contact you: Your auto adjuster will call within 24 hours, and the inspection will happen within 3 business days.
After my neighbor's basement flooded from the sewer I want to make sure I'm covered. I have Essential. What do I add?

Next step: Add the endorsement in Granite Mobile under Policy > Coverages; you'll see the premium change before confirming.
Who will contact you: Policy Service will confirm the endorsement and post your updated declarations page within 4 business hours.
What's the first-contact SLA after FNOL? Auto vs home

After first notice of loss, the assigned adjuster must make first contact within 24 hours for auto claims and within 48 hours for HomeShield claims. During a declared CAT event the window extends to 72 hours. The GC- claim number is issued immediately at FNOL regardless of channel (Granite Mobile, ClaimTrack or the Claims Line at 555-0186).
Remind me of the ClaimTrack stage order? Customer is asking what comes after Inspection.

ClaimTrack stages run Reported → Assigned → Inspection → Estimate → Settlement → Paid → Closed. After Inspection comes Estimate; for PhotoEstimate claims the estimate posts within 2 business days of the photo upload. Every stage change pushes a notification to the customer's Granite Mobile app.
Which 8 photos does PhotoEstimate require?

The 4 corners of the vehicle, 2 close-ups of the damage, the VIN plate and the odometer. The estimate posts within 2 business days after all 8 are uploaded. If the vehicle isn't drivable, skip PhotoEstimate; an adjuster inspects it at the tow yard or shop within 3 business days.
Customer hired their own water mitigation company before calling us. Bill is $3,100. Do they need approval?

Emergency mitigation (tarping, water extraction, board-up) is reimbursed up to $2,500 without pre-approval, as long as the customer provides receipts. The remaining $600 needs the property adjuster's review before it can be approved. Have the customer upload the full invoice to ClaimTrack. Next time, Granite Rapid Response vendors can be dispatched within 4 hours through the Claims Line.
how do I calculate the wind/hail deductible

It's 2% of Coverage A (dwelling), as listed on the declarations page. Example: Coverage A of $280,000 means a $5,600 wind/hail deductible. It applies instead of the all-perils deductible ($500 / $1,000 / $2,500, default $1,000) only for wind and hail losses.
Quick one: SafeMiles discount bands?

5% enrollment discount right away. After the 90-day scoring period, the renewal discount follows the SafeMiles score (0–100): 90+ = 25%, 80–89 = 15%, 70–79 = 10%, and below 70 the customer keeps the 5%. SafeMiles never raises a premium. The program lead is Daria Lindqvist.
Customer lost their second SafeMiles tag this term. Do we charge?
Yes. A SafeMiles Tag SM-200 replacement is free once per policy term; a second replacement in the same term costs $15. It ships within 5 business days of the request.
When exactly does the $10 late fee hit?

Only after the 10-day grace period that follows the due date. A payment made on day 10 or earlier has no late fee. If the balance stays unpaid, a cancellation notice gives the customer 20 days to pay before the policy cancels.
Policy canceled for nonpayment 3 weeks ago, customer wants to reinstate. Can they?

Yes. Reinstatement with no lapse is allowed within 30 days of cancellation if the customer pays in full and signs a no-loss statement confirming no losses since the cancellation date. At 3 weeks they're still inside the window; after 30 days they'd need a new policy. Billing questions go to Felix Arundel's Policy Service & Billing team.
What's the total loss threshold again?

A vehicle is a total loss when the repair estimate exceeds 75% of its actual cash value (ACV). The valuation is completed within 5 business days of the inspection, and rental coverage, if the customer has it, continues for 5 days after the total loss offer. Stolen vehicles not recovered within 14 days are also settled as total losses.
How long does subrogation usually take before the customer gets their deductible back?

Typically 60–120 days. When the other driver is at fault, Granite pursues subrogation and refunds the customer's deductible in proportion to the amount recovered; for example, an 80% recovery refunds 80% of the deductible.
Customer bought a car 10 days ago and is only now telling us. Is it covered?

Yes. A newly acquired vehicle is covered automatically for 14 days as long as it's reported within those 14 days. At day 10 they're inside the window; add the vehicle today so new ID cards and an updated declarations page are issued.
Where are the drive-in claim centers and what are the hours?

Cedar Bluff (HQ, 400 Quarry Lane), Ridgeview and Lowell Flats. All three are open Mon–Fri 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. MT and no appointment is needed. Customers should report the claim first and bring their GC- claim number.
Customer wants to dispute a coverage denial. Where does that go?

Coverage disputes and formal complaints go to Tier 3, the Claims Review Desk, which responds within 2 business days. Tier 2 is the adjuster team lead (Owen Thackeray for auto, Beatrix Holloway for property) for service issues such as missed callbacks. Tier 1 is Customer Care and claims intake.
who's the property claims lead

Beatrix Holloway leads HomeShield Property Claims and is the Tier 2 escalation point for property files. For reference: Owen Thackeray leads Auto Claims, Marisol Quenneville manages the Claims Contact Center, Felix Arundel leads Policy Service & Billing, and Daria Lindqvist runs SafeMiles.
Dwelling payment is $8,400. Does the mortgage company go on the check?

No. The mortgage company is added as co-payee only on HomeShield dwelling payments over $10,000. An $8,400 dwelling payment goes to the policyholder alone and can be sent by direct deposit through ClaimTrack.
Rental limits by auto tier?

Granite Auto Basic: no rental unless the customer added the $4/month endorsement ($30/day for up to 30 days). Granite Auto Plus: $40/day for up to 30 days. Granite Auto Premier: $60/day for up to 30 days. On a total loss, rental continues for 5 days after the offer.
How long can a HomeShield customer get ALE?

Additional living expenses are covered up to 6 months on HomeShield Essential and up to 12 months on HomeShield Plus while the home is unlivable after a covered loss. Customers should upload hotel and meal receipts to ClaimTrack.
Customer wants a callback Saturday afternoon, is Customer Care even open?

Customer Care (555-0129) is open Saturdays 8:00 a.m.–2:00 p.m. Mountain Time, so schedule the callback before 2:00 p.m. MT. Weekday hours are 7:00 a.m.–8:00 p.m. MT, and it's closed Sundays. The Claims Line (555-0186) is open 24/7 for FNOL, roadside and mitigation dispatch.
Check vs direct deposit: how fast does each arrive after settlement? And does the windshield deductible apply on Plus?

Payment is issued within 5 business days of the signed settlement. Direct deposit through ClaimTrack lands 1–2 business days after issue; a mailed check takes 7–10 business days. On the windshield: chip repair is $0 deductible on every tier, but replacement on Plus uses the comprehensive deductible. Only Premier has $0 windshield replacement.
